_note: SecurityInsight's closed setup lists for the status report Kind=setup (framework 8.7). Ids are stable and lower-case and are never removed: one that is no longer used is marked retired. The release hands this file over to Invardia as setup-catalog.json with the released version.

controls.title: Updater deployed
controls.why: Without the updater the install never receives the fixes and security updates approved for its ring.
controls.fix: Run the guided install again for this environment; it deploys the updater job.

controls.title: Updater schedule enabled
controls.why: A deployed updater that is not scheduled never runs, so the install falls behind its ring.
controls.fix: Turn on updates from Invardia (Settings > Licence and updates) and make sure the updater job has its schedule.

controls.title: Update ring set
controls.why: The ring decides which approved version the install receives; without it the updater cannot choose a version.
controls.fix: Set the Update ring on the Settings page (Licence and updates), or run setup\Set-SIInstallRing.ps1 -Ring <1-3>.

controls.title: Install key present
controls.why: The install key lets the install report its health to Invardia and receive Pro updates.
controls.fix: Let the updater claim the install key (Settings > Updates, 'claim it again'), or contact support if the claim is refused.

controls.title: Licence valid
controls.why: Pro features and Pro updates need a valid licence for this tenant.
controls.fix: Load the current licence from the customer portal, or let the install request it automatically (Settings > Licence and updates).

controls.title: Mail sender works
controls.why: Reports and alerts go out by mail; if the sender fails, nobody hears about problems.
controls.fix: Check the mail settings on the Settings page and send a test mail. With a shared mailbox, the send right must be limited to that mailbox.

controls.title: Alert recipients set
controls.why: Alerts need at least one person to receive them.
controls.fix: Add at least one recipient for the safety-check mails on the Settings page (Mail and notifications).

controls.title: Identity permissions complete
controls.why: The identity the jobs run as needs every permission SecurityInsight lists; a missing one makes jobs fail or skip data.
controls.fix: Run the permission check and grant the permissions it lists as missing, then run the jobs again.

controls.title: Last successful run within 24 hours
controls.why: No successful run for a day means the data and reports are out of date.
controls.fix: Open Run health, fix the job that failed, and start it again.

controls.title: Backup configured
controls.why: Without a backup a lost or broken configuration cannot be restored.
controls.fix: Turn on the configuration backup on the Settings page and check that its storage is reachable.

controls.title: Update held on purpose
controls.why: An install held on its version on purpose is shown as held, not as behind its ring.
controls.fix: Release the hold on the Settings page (Updates) when it is no longer needed.

controls.title: SQL database reachable
controls.why: Every install keeps its records, settings and correlation in its SQL database; if it cannot be reached, the jobs stop.
controls.fix: Check that the database server is running and that the job identity can sign in to it (the permission check).

controls.title: Jobs set up as designed
controls.why: A job missing or set up differently from the design can leave steps of the daily run undone.
controls.fix: Run the guided install again for this environment; it puts the jobs back as designed.

controls.title: Job run limits fit the tenant
controls.why: A job whose time limit is too short for the size of the tenant is stopped before it finishes.
controls.fix: Run the guided install again; it sizes the job limits for the number of assets and identities in the tenant.

controls.title: Last daily run completed
controls.why: The daily run collects, correlates and reports; a failed or skipped step leaves its data out of date.
controls.fix: Open Run health, look at the step that failed or was skipped, fix it and start the daily run again.

controls.title: Every data source returned data
controls.why: A source that returns nothing (for example the exposure graph, Azure Resource Graph or Entra ID) hides assets and findings.
controls.fix: Check the permissions and licences for the source that returned nothing (the permission check), then run the collection again.

controls.title: Last configuration item build succeeded
controls.why: The configuration items (CIs) group the assets for ownership and reporting; a failed build leaves them out of date.
controls.fix: Open Run health for the CI build, fix the cause and start it again.

controls.title: Log Analytics ingestion working
controls.why: Run health and the reports are written to Log Analytics; if ingestion fails, the results cannot be seen.
controls.fix: Check the data collection rule and the job identity's right to send data to it, then run a job and look for its run-health record.

controls.title: Licence edition
controls.why: Shows which edition the licence of this install is for, so support knows which features apply.
controls.fix: If the edition is not the one you bought, load the current licence from the customer portal.

controls.title: Secure secret hand-over ready
controls.why: Secrets pasted in the web app are stored in Key Vault by the updater with its hand-over key; without that right they wait and are never stored.
controls.fix: Run the updater setup again with its role grants: .\setup\Install-SIUpdaterJob.ps1 -SubscriptionId <subscription id> -ResourceGroupName <resource group> -GrantSpnRoles
